topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I learned that my child would have the same teacher I once did, a wave of memories washed over me. It's a small world, after all. I remember how much I looked forward to her class, the way she made learning come alive. The room was always filled with sunlight, and her smile could light up even the dullest day. It feels like a distant echo now. I hope this year brings my child as much joy as it brought me, but the world moves so fast, and things aren't the same. Still, I'll try to hold on to the hope that some things never change.
